original_test_intent: Verify all listed BIOS processor identity, socket, logical count, speed/frequency, CPUID, microcode, stepping and cache fields match the approved CPU specification, with OS corroboration.
original_method: Operator captures both BIOS paths without changes; after boot, agent securely collects full dmidecode/lscpu/proc/cache/microcode evidence; engineer maps each field to its authoritative surface and resolves differences.
manual_activity: Operator/KVM captures System Information->Processor Information and Advanced->Processor Settings; agent collects secure OS corroboration afterward.
required_inputs: Approved CPU/board/BIOS/firmware and versioned CPU specification
Qualified operator/KVM and screenshots of both BIOS paths
Field authority for dynamic/optional values including current speed, microcode and cache topology
Secure Linux access with dmidecode/lscpu/proc/sysfs/microcode tools
Thermal/SEL abort, safe BIOS exit and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Navigate BIOS read-only and exit without unintended save
Use secure managed OS session rather than repeated unsafe SSH
Preserve raw data and unavailable fields
Stop on wrong system, BIOS/thermal/SEL/boot warning or unexplained contradiction
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw OS processor/cache/frequency/microcode evidence after operator boot
Build field-by-field BIOS/OS/spec table without verdict
Do not claim screen values, alter BIOS, treat OS as BIOS proof or resolve missing authority by assumption

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Full dmidecode/lscpu are useful corroboration, but repeated sshpass/host-key bypass is unsafe and OS values do not prove BIOS display.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one audited secure read-only session to collect complete dmidecode, lscpu, /proc, cache sysfs and microcode data after manual screen capture.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All13 listed BIOS fields, both paths, specification comparison and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture immutable BIOS pages and reconcile each named field against raw OS evidence with explicit authority/unavailable status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure collection, field provenance, discrepancy policy and safe exit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS records cannot replace BIOS visibility for this testcase.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dynamic frequency, microcode exposure and cache aggregation can differ by surface and firmware/tool version.

project_override_considerations: Project must define authoritative source per field; discrepancies are recorded, not silently normalized.
expected_evidence: Screenshots/photos of both BIOS paths and every listed field
dmesg/syslog/SEL, thermal state, exit-without-save and final health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, detailed BIOS procedure and CPU-spec criterion align. Field authority and expected values are readiness inputs rather than source contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator/KVM, spec and OS tools can be supplied; hybrid evidence collection is feasible.

review_improvement: Maintains BIOS authority and adds secure field-level provenance so OS equivalents cannot silently replace firmware coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: BIOS, SMBIOS and OS may legitimately expose different current speed, microcode or cache aggregation. A correct review cannot flatten those into one value; it must record each surface and the project-designated authority. Manual screenshots plus raw OS outputs create that traceability.
